events.subtitle: Pride And Joy — 35th-anniversary rock and blues quartet
events.category: Japanese rock and blues lineage / 35th-anniversary quartet
events.factual_description: Billboard Live Tokyo announced Reiran's Pride And Joy engagement on November 14, 2026 for January 30, 2027. The quartet pairs Reiichi 'CHABO' Nakaido of RC Succession lineage with Kohei 'Ranmalu' Tsuchiya of The Street Sliders, plus bassist Takeharu Hayakawa and drummer Jah-Rah. The venue presents it within Reiran's 35th-anniversary period, with sets at 16:00 and 19:00 and listed per-person charges from ¥8,500 to ¥11,200.

en.why_it_matters: Nakaido and Tsuchiya are not appearing as isolated legacy names: Reiran is the durable guitar partnership they built around a shared vocabulary of blues, R&B and Japanese rock, with Hayakawa and Jah-Rah completing the working quartet. Hearing that four-person chemistry at club scale during its 35th-anniversary cycle gives this performance a concrete musical reason to belong.
en.trip_verdict: Make room for one of the Tokyo sets if January travel overlaps. The exact quartet and club scale earn A+, while the Osaka stop and anniversary tour context make A+ the sufficient recommendation.

es.why_it_matters: Nakaido y Tsuchiya no llegan como dos nombres históricos sueltos: Reiran es la alianza guitarrística que construyeron alrededor del blues, el R&B y el rock japonés, con Hayakawa y Jah-Rah como sección rítmica del cuarteto activo. Escuchar esa química de cuatro músicos en formato de club durante su ciclo de 35 años le da a la fecha una razón musical concreta para entrar.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio a uno de los sets si el viaje de enero coincide con Tokio. El cuarteto exacto y la escala del club justifican A+; la parada en Osaka y el contexto de gira de aniversario hacen que A+ sea suficiente, sin convertirla en una noche de escasez excepcional.

events.artist: Gonzalo Rubalcaba / Chris Potter / Larry Grenadier / Eric Harland
events.subtitle: First Meeting
events.factual_description: Blue Note New York bills First Meeting, a quartet of Gonzalo Rubalcaba, Chris Potter, Larry Grenadier and Eric Harland, for April 27 through May 2, 2027. The six-night residency has two performances nightly at 20:00 and 22:30, with doors at 18:00 for the early set and 22:00 for the late set. The venue states a $20 per-person food-and-beverage minimum; that minimum is not recorded as a ticket price.

en.why_it_matters: The draw is the untested architecture of this exact quartet: Rubalcaba's rhythmic piano language, Potter's long-form improvising, Grenadier's elastic bass center and Harland's ability to reshape meter in real time. A first meeting across a full residency offers room for the ensemble to change night by night rather than merely assembling four celebrated names.
en.trip_verdict: Actively prioritize a set if New York is reachable during the residency. The first encounter and exact quartet earn A+, but twelve sets across six nights make A+ more honest than treating any single performance as scarce enough for S.

es.why_it_matters: El atractivo está en la arquitectura todavía no probada de este cuarteto: el lenguaje rítmico del piano de Rubalcaba, la improvisación de largo aliento de Potter, el centro elástico del bajo de Grenadier y la forma en que Harland transforma el pulso en tiempo real. Un primer encuentro a lo largo de una residencia permite escuchar cómo cambia la banda noche tras noche, no sólo reunir cuatro nombres celebrados.
es.trip_verdict: Priorizaría activamente un set si Nueva York queda al alcance durante la residencia. El primer encuentro y el cuarteto exacto merecen A+, pero doce sets en seis noches hacen más honesto A+ que tratar una sola función como suficientemente escasa para S.

events.artist: John Patitucci / Beka Gochiashvili / Dave Weckl
events.subtitle: For Chick
events.category: Chick Corea lineage / Akoustic Band reunion project
events.factual_description: Blue Note New York presents For Chick from May 20 through May 23, 2027, with two performances nightly at 20:00 and 22:30. Founding Chick Corea Akoustic Band members John Patitucci and Dave Weckl reunite with pianist Beka Gochiashvili, who was mentored by Corea. The international tour supports a new 12-track album recorded in Brooklyn in December 2025, drawing on Akoustic Band repertoire, less expected Corea compositions and two new originals. The venue states a $20 per-person food-and-beverage minimum; it is not treated as a ticket price.

en.why_it_matters: This is not a generic tribute set: Patitucci and Weckl carry the Akoustic Band's original rhythmic memory, while Gochiashvili brings a pianist personally mentored by Corea into a new trio built around familiar repertoire, overlooked pieces and new writing. The value lies in hearing inheritance tested through an active working project rather than preserved as museum repertory.
en.trip_verdict: Make room for a Blue Note set if May travel can reach New York. The lineage and new-album trio warrant A+, while the documented world tour and eight New York sets make A+ the sufficient recommendation.

es.why_it_matters: No es un homenaje genérico: Patitucci y Weckl conservan la memoria rítmica original de la Akoustic Band, mientras Gochiashvili —pianista formado de cerca por Corea— entra a un trío nuevo que trabaja repertorio conocido, piezas menos obvias y composiciones nuevas. El interés está en escuchar una herencia puesta a prueba por un proyecto activo, no conservada como repertorio de museo.
es.trip_verdict: Le haría espacio a un set del Blue Note si el viaje de mayo puede llegar a Nueva York. El linaje y el trío del álbum nuevo justifican A+; la gira mundial documentada y ocho sets neoyorquinos hacen que A+ sea la recomendación suficiente.
